run_generate_video: run generate_video with a prompt file, reference images, and output file path to generate a video via Gemini API
run_download: run download to fetch a video from a Gemini API URL and save it to a local output file
run_cli_generate: run the CLI entry point with --prompt-file, --reference-images, --output-file, and optional --aspect-ratio arguments
refactor_generate_video: refactor generate_video to support custom API endpoints and retry logic with exponential backoff
review_download: review the download function for error handling when the API key is missing or the HTTP request fails
